agent.name: Miyagi Sánchez — Platform Migrations Connector
agent.description: Reads a merchant's own product catalog (read-only) to help them migrate it into their own shop on miyagisanchez.com (Miyagi Sánchez: your own online shop, built with you, with no commission on sales). Used only when a merchant explicitly starts a migration from their own shop domain. Declares no checkout, cart, or payment capability — this agent never transacts.
